gameDescriptionHtml:
A 3D adventure combining precise platforming action with environmental puzzles. Purify the corrupted Primal Gate and restore the flow of time to a shattered world.

Game Features

  • Precision Action Meets Puzzles – Forget about simple jumps. Experience the true essence of platforming with a blend of dodging, gliding, and timing-based mechanics. Your mastery of control is the key to solving every puzzle.
  • Explore a Hauntingly Beautiful World – Traverse lifeless ruins and geometrically twisted forests. The rifts left by the shattered ‘Primal Gate’ create a visual atmosphere that is as stunning as it is unsettling.
  • A Deep Resonance Beyond Words – No text or dialogue is required. Immerse yourself in a narrative conveyed entirely through environmental shifts, evocative music, and Nia’s movements.
